What they share

Different problems. The same rules of construction.

Start from the process, not the tool

The client's vocabulary goes into the system as it is: their manuals, their statuses, their roles. We do not bend the company around generic software.

AI with clear limits

The assistant answers only from the documents and cites the source. The agent does only what the user's role allows. What it does not know, it says it does not know.

Owned by the client

The data lives in the client's database; the workflows run on their infrastructure. Nothing is used to train any model.
